<a id="WorldScape3DTextureAsset"></a>

# WorldScape3DTextureAsset

**Inherits:** [WorldScape3DAssetResource](WorldScape3DAssetResource.md) **\<** [Resource](Resource.md) **\<** [RefCounted](RefCounted.md) **\<** [Object](Object.md)

<!-- classref-introduction-group -->

## Description

A set of texture files and settings that gets added to a [WorldScape3DAssets](WorldScape3DAssets.md) resource. Textures must be prepared.
